svg.title: An AI client connected to RimWorld through RiMCP
svg.desc: A simple white robot on the left, a mint RiMCP block in the middle, and the RimWorld logo on the right, linked by two bidirectional arrows on a dark background.
svg.metadata: Robot icon drawn for RiMCP. RimWorld mark: Ludeon Studios public art kit linked at https://ludeon.com/blog/faq/ . The RimWorld mark belongs to Ludeon Studios and identifies the connected game, not an endorsement.
